segments.says: If the same request lands twice - say the app retried after a timeout even though the server had actually finished, or someone tapped Pay two times - the end result should be as if it only happened once.
Think of a lift call button: mash it five times and one lift still comes.
An API call should work the same way.
because in real life stuff gets sent twice all the time - flaky wifi resends, impatient people double-tap, a client gives up waiting after the server already did the job.
